hypothesisForNextPatch: For stable market hover, reuse a framing result derived from a conservative all-animation envelope and invalidate it only when the hovered item, viewport, HUD obstacles, or market contents change, instead of calling fitSubject every frame.
warnings: Inclusive values overlap and must not be summed.
CPU self or inclusive time is not a percentage of frame time.
GPU and driver work may appear as idle or native time in a V8 CPU profile.
The profile is diagnostic and cannot make the existing performance gates pass.

architectureReview.constraint: Do not freeze the final camera from the proposed invalidation list. Local all-animation bounds do not alone cover hover world motion, parent transforms, authored camera or moving ownership tokens; sampled phases are not a proof over continuous time.
architectureReview.nextStep: Separate reusable local geometry data from per-frame world projection and establish invalidation counterexamples before patching.
